question: A high level source program must be translated first into a form that the machine can understand. This is done using a software called the:
solution:
The correct answer is __**compiler**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A** high level source program** must be translated first into a form that the machine can understand.
 
• This translation is done using a software called the **compiler**.
 
• The compiler **converts the entire program into machine code before execution**.
 
• It performs syntax analysis, semantic analysis, and optimizations during the translation process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An **assembler** is used to** convert assembly language code into machine code**.
 
• A **debugger** is used to **test and debug programs** by allowing the programmer to step through the code and inspect variables.
 
• A **controller** is a generic term and is not specifically related to the translation of high-level source code.
